front.title: Selective Merkle Disclosure CBOR Web Tokens (SMD-CWT)

abstract.t: This document specifies an extension to Selective Disclosure CBOR Web Tokens (SD-CWT) that reduces their size and improves their privacy properties. In this extension, the individual hashes of the redacted claims of a map or an array are replaced with the root hash of a Merkle tree, and disclosed claims are presented with a Merkle proof.
